**Airway 0.9.0 (build 6)**, the signed app from [airway.fan](https://airway.fan/download). Download `Airway-0.9.0.dmg` below.

> [!NOTE]
> This download is the paid edition of Airway. It starts with a 7-day free trial, then needs a license from [airway.fan](https://airway.fan) ($1.99 once, for two Macs). It also updates itself. To get every feature for free, [build OpenAirway yourself](https://github.com/jc-gt3rs/OpenAirway#build-it-yourself).

## What's new

- **Smart presets with fan curves.** Pick a curve (Gentle, Linear, Responsive, Smooth or Instant), the temperatures where it starts and reaches full speed, a top speed, and which temperature to follow. Turn on **Use Smart in Auto** to let the curve drive Auto mode too.
- **More temperatures.** Per-sensor readings for CPU, GPU, memory, SSD, power, ambient and battery, plus CPU and CPU/GPU averages. Choose which one the menu bar, Siri and Auto follow.
- **A Settings window** styled like System Settings, with an appearance picker that previews Airway's own popover.
- **Manual speeds below 25%**, opt-in and behind a warning.
- **Siri and Shortcuts overhaul** for macOS 27.
- **Stronger safety.** If Airway quits unexpectedly, the helper hands the fans back to macOS after 15 seconds. A manual speed that lets the Mac reach 100 °C for 5 seconds now forces Max right away, on top of the 90 °C for 3 minutes rule. Sleep no longer counts as sustained heat.
- **Diagnostics** for bug reports: thermal recordings that delete themselves after 24 hours unless you keep them, a daily local log kept for 7 days, and an SMC key dump.
- Smoother popover scrolling and animations, windows that fit every screen size, and a fix so saved presets are never wiped.

## Install

1. Open the DMG and drag **Airway** into **Applications**.
2. Open Airway. macOS says it "could not verify Airway is free of malware" because Airway isn't notarized by Apple yet. Click **Done**.
3. Open **System Settings > Privacy & Security**, find "Airway was blocked to protect your Mac", and click **Open Anyway**.
4. In **System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions**, turn Airway on under **Allow in the Background**. Airway appears in your menu bar.

The full walkthrough is at [airway.fan/install](https://airway.fan/install).

**Requires** macOS 13 Ventura or later on an Apple Silicon or Intel Mac with fans.
